verdict.rationale: Scribe returns transcripts as structured JSON with segments, speaker or channel labels, and timing fields. Batch jobs write transcripts into the customer's own S3 storage, next to the input files. Documented list/get endpoints exist for job files and vocabulary assets, so the user's core artifacts are retrievable in an open format. However, nothing documents an explicit 'export all my data' or account offboarding/deletion path. missing for 10: documented bulk/full-account data export, offboarding or data-deletion guidance, coverage of job history and polished outputs in an export, independent corroboration.
